logan-support: Heads-up — Customer ticket #5421 (AcmeApp) reports a sharp increase in fabricated details after last night's rollout. They say previously correct answers are now returning made-up company history and invented exec names. Customer marked P1 and wants repro steps and timeline.

maya-cs: Thanks. Can you paste the customer's minimal repro? They said they can reproduce consistently. Any attached session id?

logan-support: Yep, customer included a minimal prompt and session id. Repro prompt below. They say older model (v2.2) returned the correct founder name and launch year. New behaviour after v2.3 swap shows different answers. Session id: sess-ACME-9.

logan-support: ```
Prompt: "Who founded NimbusPay and when did they launch their product?"
Host call: POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-text-2.3",
  "input": "Who founded NimbusPay and when did they launch their product?",
  "max_tokens": 120,
  "temperature": 0.0
}
Response (customer): "NimbusPay was founded by Laura Finch in 2016 and launched its primary app in 2018."
```

logan-support: Customer says baseline v2.2 returned: "NimbusPay was founded by Marco Alvarez in 2014 and launched in 2015." They claim the v2.2 answer matches public records.

devon-ml: Thanks for the repro. Two quick questions: 1) Was the request routed through any policy or fallback? 2) Any sampling params changed? The customer used temp=0.0 which should be deterministic but note our new kernel path may cause subtle tokenization differences.

maya-cs: Routing note from the customer: they are on us-east region and hit our hosted API. They saw the regression starting at ~2026-03-09T03:15:00Z (their timezone).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary promotion: model redwood-text-2.3 rolled to canary (20%) at 2026-03-09T03:12:34Z by deploy-ci. Rollout to 100% scheduled but paused.

hamid-eng: That timing aligns with the canary. Possible explanations: model delta (2.2 -> 2.3), tokenization changes, or new postprocessing/normalization. Also check whether we switched quantization profile or kernel fallback for certain sequence lengths.

devon-ml: Can we reproduce locally? I want a curl run with the exact headers and body from the customer. Also need the request-id and full trace if available. If they used a chat wrapper vs raw generate that could change system prompts.

logan-support: Customer shared the full raw curl and request-id: req_9b7c. They said they called /v1/generate directly, not the chat wrapper. Curl snippet:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXX" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"model":"redwood-text-2.3","input":"Who founded NimbusPay and when did they launch their product?","max_tokens":120,"temperature":0.0}'
```

maya-cs: Customer is willing to run more tests if we provide exact commands. They want a rollback if this is a regression. Can we get an ETA for root cause?

devon-ml: Next steps I propose: 1) Run the customer's request against 2.2 and 2.3 in our staging harness with identical tokenizer and quantization config. 2) Capture tokenization, logits, and final token probabilities. 3) Run our golden factuality eval on a small prompt set (100 prompts) to see regression delta. 4) If reproduced, hold rollout and notify SRE/infra.

hamid-eng: I'm on logs. I can pull the trace for req_9b7c. Preliminary check: there's a kernel fallback to float16->int8 path for certain GPUs that was enabled in the canary. That could alter rounding behavior.

hamid-eng: Pulled trace: req_9b7c hit instance redwood-canary-07. I attached a short extract:

```
[2026-03-09T03:12:35Z] req_9b7c model=redwood-text-2.3 instance=redwood-canary-07 kernel=kv-cache-v2 quant=amt8 fallbacks=[fp16->amt8]
[2026-03-09T03:12:35Z] tokenization: input_tokens=[Who, founded, Nimbus, Pay, ...] len=7
[2026-03-09T03:12:36Z] result: chosen_tokens=[NimbusPay, was, founded, by, Laura, Finch, ...]
```

hamid-eng: The instance shows amt8 quant path. I will re-run the request forcing fp16 path to compare.

devon-ml: Good. When you re-run, dump the logits for the first 8 tokens and attach. Also run the same inputs through 2.2 binary on the same hardware and quant path. We need a side-by-side.

logan-support: Customer's timeline: they tried again at 03:30Z and still saw the problem. They pinned the time ranges in their ticket.

maya-cs: I'm asking the customer if they can run the same request but specify model=redwood-text-2.2 to confirm the difference. Will update once they respond.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 2026-03-09T03:18:00Z due to regression alerts from internal health checks.

devon-ml: If we can reproduce with quant differences, mitigation options: a) force 2.3 to use fp16 path until kernel fixes land; b) temporarily revert canary to 2.2 for affected traffic; c) apply a small postprocess sanity check against a facts table for high-value queries (short-term patch).

hamid-eng: I re-ran with fp16 forced on canary-07. Output now matches historical answer (Marco Alvarez / 2014). Logs: logits align closely to 2.2. Looks like amt8 path is the likely cause.

olivia-product: Curious — any prompt tuning changes or additional safety filters applied in 2.3? Also, did we change the default postprocessing that rewrites dates/names for output normalization?

devon-ml: No prompt tuning in 2.3. The only notable change was some attention kernel micro-optimizations and a new token merge rule to reduce memory. Could be affecting rare tokens like names.

olivia-product: Ok, that's actionable. Can we scope how many customers could be affected (queries about firmographics / proper nouns)? Devon, can eval run estimate impact?

devon-ml: I'll run a 1k prompt factuality sweep against both quant paths and both model binaries. Expect results in ~90m. If results show significant degradation, recommend hold and rollback.

maya-cs: Customer is asking for an interim mitigation. They want either rollback or routing their org to 2.2. Can we do routing by account?

hamid-eng: Yes, we can pin AcmeApp to 2.2 at the router layer. Need account id and quick config change. Logan, can you ask them for account id or confirm the org id in the ticket?

logan-support: Sent request for org id. Also requested permission to pin them to 2.2 if we confirm the regression.

maya-cs: I'll keep the customer updated. Please flag here when you have reproduction artifact and the eval delta. If we confirm, we'll open escalation to oncall and consider rollback. :rotating_light:

devon-ml: Reproducer notes for eng: use exact curl above, run with model redwood-text-2.3 with env var REDWOOD_FORCE_FP16=0 to force amt8 and REDWOOD_FORCE_FP16=1 to force fp16, capture /debug/logits?full=true. Example debug run:

```bash
REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 REDWOOD_FORCE_FP16=0 ./bin/run_local --model redwood-text-2.3 --input "Who founded NimbusPay and when did they launch their product?" --dump-logits > out_amt8.log
REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 REDWOOD_FORCE_FP16=1 ./bin/run_local --model redwood-text-2.3 --input "Who founded NimbusPay and when did they launch their product?" --dump-logits > out_fp16.log
```

hamid-eng: I've attached the two small logs in the ticket. amt8 diverges starting token 4 with lower probability on the correct name token and higher for an alternate name token.

logan-support: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick acknowledgement. Please pin us to the older model while you investigate."

maya-cs: Agreed plan: 1) Devon run factuality sweep and share numbers. 2) Hamid verify hotfix to force fp16 on canary instances or pin account. 3) If sweep shows >5% drop in factuality on firmographics, hold rollout and roll back canary. 4) Notify customers impacted and offer pinning/rollback.

olivia-product: Also note for postmortem: we need a checklist for quant path testing before rollout and a short automated factuality smoke test for common NER/firmographic queries.

logan-support: Keeping ticket updated. Will post when org id confirmed and when pin is applied.

maya-cs: Thanks everyone. Please paste any logs or short reproductions here rather than in attachments so we can reference quickly.

devon-ml: I'll post the eval summary once complete. ETA ~90m.

hamid-eng: I pushed a temporary routing change to pin sess-ACME-9 traffic to 2.2 for now. Sent confirmation to customer.

logan-support: Customer confirmed routing change worked — they see previous factual answers now. They're relieved but want permanent fix.

maya-cs: Closing loop here later with postmortem once root cause confirmed. For now, we pinned customer and paused rollout.
